items.description: A raw INSERT into stock_adjustments with sku NULL is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the paired branch
A raw INSERT into stock_adjustments with new_quantity below zero is rejected by ck_stock_adjustments_quantities_non_negative on the paired branch
A raw INSERT into stock_adjustments for a (sku, location) pair absent from stock_records is rejected by the composite foreign key on the paired branch

Downgrading to the create_stock_adjustments migration's own down_revision then upgrading head recreates stock_adjustments with its columns, CHECKs, composite FK and immutability trigger (marked @pytest.mark.migration, no relative downgrade)

stock_records rows seeded with per-run-unique keys before upgrading to the create_stock_adjustments revision persist unchanged after the upgrade and after a downgrade to its down_revision (marked @pytest.mark.migration)
The integration test session fixture asserts the engine dialect is postgresql and the URL is the paired branch DATABASE_URL, failing fast on sqlite, in-memory or mocked sessions
POST /api/adjustments for an existing (sku, location) at quantity 7 with quantity 4 and an actor returns 201 naming the sku, location, prior_quantity 7, new_quantity 4 and the entered actor
After one successful adjustment, GET /api/adjustments?sku=&location= returns exactly one audit record for the pair with the prior quantity, new quantity and actor
The audit record's adjusted_at is a server-stamped ISO-8601 UTC time falling between just before and just after the POST
Two successive adjustments of the same pair yield two audit records listed newest first, the second with prior_quantity equal to the first's new_quantity
Adjusting a pair does not return or list audit records belonging to a different (sku, location) pair
POST /api/adjustments with an empty actor returns 422 whose detail names the 'actor' field
POST /api/adjustments with a whitespace-only actor returns 422 whose detail names the 'actor' field
POST /api/adjustments with the actor field omitted returns 422 whose detail names the 'actor' field
After a rejected empty-actor POST, GET /api/adjustments for the pair returns [] so no audit record was created
POST /api/adjustments for a (sku, location) with no stock record returns 404 and lists no audit record for that pair

When the audit insert is forced to fail inside AdjustmentService.adjust_to_value (called with its injected session), stock_records.quantity is unchanged and no stock_adjustments row exists on the paired branch
A direct UPDATE of a stock_adjustments row is rejected by the immutability trigger and the row keeps its original values on the paired branch
PUT on /api/adjustments/{id} for an existing audit record returns 405 and GET still returns the record with its original values
PATCH on /api/adjustments/{id} for an existing audit record returns 405 and GET still returns the record with its original values
DELETE on /api/adjustments/{id} for an existing audit record returns 405 and GET still returns the record with its original values
Every /api/adjustments response (201, 422, 404, 405 and the GET list) has content type application/json and never text/html
A raw INSERT into stock_adjustments with an empty-string actor is rejected by ck_stock_adjustments_actor_non_blank on the paired branch
POST /api/adjustments with an empty actor returns 422 whose detail names the 'actor' field
POST /api/adjustments with an empty actor leaves stock_records.quantity unchanged for the pair
POST /api/adjustments with an empty actor writes no stock_adjustments row for the pair (delta of the test's own rows is zero)
AdjustmentService.adjust_to_value called with its injected session and a blank actor never reaches the repository write (patched repository write is assert-not-called)
AdjustForm renders field-actor-error naming 'Your name' on a field--error actor field when the actor is left empty
AdjustForm still shows adjust-current-qty as 7 after the empty-actor submit is rejected
AdjustForm renders the adjust-audit-empty state with no audit row after the empty-actor submit is rejected

Playwright e2e at route /adjust against the live DB (per-run-unique sku at quantity 7): submitting a corrected quantity with the actor field empty shows an inline field-actor-error next to field-actor naming 'Your name'

Playwright e2e at route /adjust against the live DB (per-run-unique sku at quantity 7): after the empty-actor rejection adjust-current-qty still shows 7 and the adjust-audit list gains no adjust-audit-row
After POST /api/adjustments sets a (sku, location) from 7 to 4, exactly one stock_records row exists for that pair carrying quantity 4
AdjustForm rendered for an existing (sku, location) pair shows its current quantity 7 read-only in the adjust-current-qty seam
AdjustForm renders every field (field-sku, field-location, field-quantity, field-actor) with a visible persistent field__label
AdjustForm renders the adjust-success confirmation naming sku, location, prior quantity 7 to new quantity 4 and actor after a real submit

Playwright e2e on the deployed app at route /adjust?sku=&location= (through the real App, live DB, per-run crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku filed at quantity 7): adjust-current-qty shows 7 and, after entering Corrected quantity 4 and Your name and clicking adjust-submit, adjust-success appears naming the sku, location, prior 7 to new 4 and actor, with toast-success
Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/*.spec.ts, same per-run-unique sku): after the adjustment succeeds, navigating to /sku/:sku shows sku-qty-<loc> with quantity 4 from the live DB
